briefing: Mythos Gates briefing: Elite: Weigh the Hidden-Sun Archive Antechamber: Antechamber Seal. Enter Hidden-Sun Archive Antechamber on Sun-Scale Verdict Descent through The Sun-Scale Gate while the Gate remains Stable Gate under Ma’at strain. Reference deity voice is Aten Ra, but the player still chooses one deity from the faction roster. Objective: With one selected deity, survive the boss approach in the elite-tuned Hidden-Sun Archive Antechamber, secure the boss approach, and enter the chamber with the route law understood.

missionIntro.speaker: Aten Ra Divine Voice
missionIntro.text: The scale waits for weight, not noise. The Hidden-Sun Archive Antechamber will know whether one deity is enough.

enemyIntroduction.speaker: Lore Director
enemyIntroduction.text: Enemies are not filler here; they are the pre boss pressure of Sun-Scale Verdict Descent made hostile.

midBattle.speaker: Gameplay Director
midBattle.text: Read the room law first: Exploit or avoid the route rule: Ma’at scale fields that immobilize anything out of balance

victory.speaker: Aten Ra Divine Voice
victory.text: The verdict remains harsh, but it names us lawful.

defeat.speaker: Aten Ra Divine Voice
defeat.text: Withdraw. The Sun-Scale Gate has learned too much from this attempt.

codex.speaker: Lore Director
codex.text: The Solar Dominion of Khepra is the source Realm; mortal myth is only the later echo. This beat documents Hidden-Sun Archive Antechamber as part of Sun-Scale Verdict Descent.

soloDeityPolicy: Dialogue supports one active battlefield deity; roster/Deity language is excluded from standard mission combat.
visualDirection: Frame Hidden-Sun Archive Antechamber as a pre boss node in Sun-Scale Verdict Descent; Aten sun-discs with life-giving hand-rays, electrum collars, nemes-like light mantles, faience turquoise and lapis inlays, black Nile silt glass, red desert jasper, scarab engines, Ma’at feather geometry, solar barque arcs, pylon harnesses, lion/cobra/falcon/jackal threshold masks, lotus-papyrus river courts, and white-gold noon light.

mythosGatesDialogueRecreation.speakerRule: Use faction divine voice, Lore Director, or Gameplay Director; no playable deity language.
mythosGatesDialogueRecreation.soloRule: Dialogue supports one active god or goddess in the field.

soloDeityPolicy: Dialogue supports one active battlefield deity; roster/deity language is excluded from player-facing copy except legacy IDs.
